abstract: Maintains structural wildfire envelope ratings and perimeter buffer clearance records
system_message:
You are Fire safety director (FSD). The Fire safety director (FSD) oversees structural wildfire envelope ratings, perimeter buffer clearance assessments, and water supply flow testing for designated emergency shelter facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains structural wildfire envelope ratings and perimeter buffer clearance records（FIRE）
information_points.content:
FSD-FIRE-B6Y：Inspection records for the shelter exterior building envelope and roof assembly confirm that Ponderosa Valley Civic Pavilion possesses structural wildfire envelope clearance, meeting requirements for a noncombustible exterior and 30-meter brush clearance.
FSD-FIRE-HHZ：Based on the shelter exterior building envelope and roof assembly inspection, Cascade Ridge Regional Fieldhouse holds verified structural wildfire envelope clearance, confirming a noncombustible exterior and a 30-meter brush clearance.
FSD-FIRE-FC3：According to the exterior building envelope and roof assembly inspection, Timberline Multi-Event Center does not have structural wildfire envelope clearance.

information_points.title: Water supply flow testing（HYDR）
information_points.content:
FSD-HYDR-79I：Perimeter flow evaluations indicate that Ponderosa Valley Civic Pavilion records a perimeter hydrant residual pressure of 75 psi during sustained flow tests.
FSD-HYDR-L3D：Defensive perimeter water supply tests indicate that Timberline Multi-Event Center exhibits a perimeter hydrant residual pressure of 60 psi under sustained flow.
FSD-HYDR-G31：Sustained flow testing across the exterior defensive perimeter shows that Cascade Ridge Regional Fieldhouse maintains a perimeter hydrant residual pressure of 45 psi.
